title: Tighten `data-objectstack`'s envelope-tolerant row extraction to the single post-unwrap spelling — after objectstack#13079's ruled convergence lands
body:
Condition 2 of the objectstack#13079 ruling (2026-08-31, director batch #19, option A approved): the SDK's four envelope-returning methods (`analytics.query` / `analytics.meta` / `analytics.explain` / `automation.trigger`) converge on `unwrapResponse`, and this tolerant chain must be tightened in the same wave so defensive coding is not read as contract.

## The site

`packages/data-objectstack/src/index.ts:4846` — the row-extraction chain accepts BOTH spellings: `data.rows` (post-unwrap) and `data.data.rows` (envelope). Today the envelope branch matches for the four unconverged methods; after convergence the post-unwrap branch matches. The caller census (objectstack PR #13647) found this is the ONLY production SDK call site in objectui — it survives convergence untouched, which is exactly why it must then be tightened: the next reader will take the tolerant chain as evidence that the producer is ambiguous by design.

## ⛔ Sequencing gate — do not start before

objectstack#13079's convergence PR is merged AND objectui has adopted the `@objectstack/*` version carrying it. Tightening FIRST breaks today's envelope reads for the four unconverged methods — the tolerant chain is currently load-bearing.

## Deliverable

Reduce the chain at this site to the single post-unwrap spelling. A pin that fails loudly if an envelope shape reappears at this boundary is welcome, scoped to this site.

Refs: objectstack#13079 (ruling + four-lens record), objectstack PR #13647 (census).
